import Foundation.HigherHeatCubicStepIdentity
import Foundation.HigherHeatQuadraticItoBoundary

open OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation
open HigherHeatPolynomialCylinders HigherHeatAnalyticCylinderDomain
open HigherHeatWeakTimeAdjoint HigherHeatSecondChannelSteps HigherHeatThirdChannelSteps
open HigherHeatCubicStepIdentity HigherHeatDyadicStepAgreement HigherHeatCompletedPairing
open HigherHeatFirstChannelRange HigherHeatQuadraticItoBoundary HigherHeatPairedDualCausality
open scoped NNReal

local instance : NeZero (size 0) := ⟨by norm_num [size, HigherHeatDyadicLaws.gridSize]⟩

example (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (j : Fin (size n)) (G : Cylinder) :
    ((firstChannel 2 T (coefficientField n 2 (by norm_num) T hT j ((MvPolynomial.X j)^2))
          (core G) +
      secondChannel 2 T (coefficientField n 2 (by norm_num) T hT j (MvPolynomial.X j))
          (core G) +
      secondChannel 2 T (coefficientField n 2 (by norm_num) T hT j (MvPolynomial.X j))
          (core G) +
      thirdChannel T (coefficientField n 2 (by norm_num) T hT j 1) (core G) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      cylindricalExpectation 2 (by norm_num) T hT (cylinderOf n ((MvPolynomial.X j)^3)*G) := by
  simpa only [one_mul] using cubic_step_actual n T hT j 1 (by simp) G

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    thirdChannel T (coefficientField 0 2 (by norm_num) T hT 0 1) (core terminalCylinder) =
      -24*(T:ℝ) := by
  have hx : (HigherHeatMultivariateMoments.terminal : Test 0) = MvPolynomial.X 0 := by
    change (∑ i : Fin 1, (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) ℝ)) = MvPolynomial.X 0
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_one]
  have hc : cylinderOf 0 ((1:Test 0)*(MvPolynomial.X 0)^3) = terminalCylinder^3 := by
    simp only [terminalCylinder, hx, one_mul, map_pow]
  have he := congrArg (fun φ : Dual => φ (core terminalCylinder))
    (cubic_step_dual 0 T hT 0 1 (by simp))
  rw [hc] at he
  simp only [add_apply, firstChannel_terminal_zero 2 (by norm_num),
    secondChannel_terminal_zero 2 (by norm_num), zero_add] at he
  rw [← he, witness_pairing]
  norm_num

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (A B : Field timeMeasure) :
    firstChannel 2 T A + secondChannel 2 T B ≠
      pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (terminalCylinder^3)) :=
  no_twoChannel_representation 2 (by norm_num) T hT A B

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    HigherHeatCompletedSignedMean.mean 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (terminalCylinder^3)) = 0 :=
  witness_centered 2 (by norm_num) T hT
